correct_answer: Payments Platform — the CMDB is the authoritative source of service ownership at Radial.
rationale: The CMDB was updated on August 21 to transfer ownership of payments-gateway from Checkout Reliability to Payments Platform via change ticket CHG-8842. The runbook still shows the old owner because it has not been synced. Under ENG-3.2 the CMDB governs when the sources disagree. The incident commander pages Payments Platform. Option B pages a team that no longer owns the service. Option C wakes both teams unnecessarily and dilutes accountability. Option D bypasses the authoritative source of record for a routing question that the CMDB already answers.
